content: The composite Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Lamp Off in case the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningLampIndicatorRef has an IndicatorStatus DEM_INDICATOR_OFF . All other IndicatorStatus states than DEM_- INDICATOR_OFF shall set the composite Amber Warning Lamp to Lamp On.
